about: Map from JV/XP internal Waves and SR-JV80 expansion-board Waves to INTEGRA-7 Wave Group and Wave Number. Research for https://github.com/sigma/integral/issues/195; see jv-wave-map.md. Checked against Roland's own JV->XV Patch conversions (https://github.com/sigma/integral/issues/206); see map-check-roland-pairs.md.

confidence.high: Same name (ignoring case, spaces, punctuation) AND a neighbouring source Wave maps within 3 Wave Numbers in the same target Wave Group AND Roland states the target carries this source. Also: Roland's own SR-JV80 -> XV conversion (pair family R02) uses this target.
confidence.medium: Two of the three: name, order, Roland statement; or a near-identical name in the slot bracketed by matched neighbours of a Roland-claimed target. Also: a target taken from a single R02 tone, or from the cross-check pair families only.
confidence.low: Name or position alone, an ambiguous candidate, or a target also claimed by a JV internal Wave.

evidence_codes.name: exact name match after normalisation
evidence_codes.name-alias: name match after substituting Roland's Rhodes -> 70'EP rename
evidence_codes.order: a neighbouring source Wave (±2) maps within 3 Wave Numbers in the same target group
evidence_codes.position: bracketed by matched neighbours; the gap has the same number of free target Waves
evidence_codes.fuzzy-window: best name similarity >= 0.6 among free target Waves between matched neighbours
evidence_codes.ambiguous: another candidate in the window is about as similar
evidence_codes.roland-board-statement: Roland's SRX manual or product page says the target board carries this SR-JV80 board
evidence_codes.roland-compat-statement: Roland says the XV-3080 plays most XP/JV Patches
evidence_codes.shared-with-jv-internal: the same target is also matched by a JV internal Wave; same recording unverified
evidence_codes.duplicate-name-in-source: the source list repeats a name; see note
evidence_codes.faxback_name (field): the Roland faxback list spells this Wave differently; name is taken from the XP-30 Owner's Manual copy of the same board
evidence_codes.outside-claimed-board: the board has a Roland-claimed SRX target, but this match lands elsewhere (name collision likely)
evidence_codes.roland-pair: Roland's 2002 SR-JV80 -> XV Patch sets (pair family R02, Roland-issued) use this target; confidence raised to high
evidence_codes.roland-pair-crosscheck: Roland factory Patches in XV format (families J2XV, JVXP, X5050; converter unknown) use this target; confidence raised one grade
evidence_codes.roland-pair-correction: target replaced by the one Roland's R02 conversion uses; the earlier answer is kept under previous
evidence_codes.roland-pair-crosscheck-correction: target replaced by the one the cross-check families use (no R02 tone); the earlier answer is kept under previous
evidence_codes.target-collision: another board's same-named MENU Wave takes this target, and Roland's pairs show same-named MENU Waves of different boards land on different SRX Waves; downgraded to low
evidence_codes.roland_pairs (field): tones per pair family and XV target ('GROUP:number') seen in Roland's paired conversions
evidence_codes.previous (field): target, confidence and evidence before the Roland-pair check
